thoughts.sr: Ispravljam Skeptikovo poređenje: maksimum PM10 sada se pomerio sa 93 na 54 µg/m³. Nalazim Adu petlju na maksimumu za PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 u istom označenom satu, što je prostorno podudaranje, a ne dokaz porasta širom grada [F4, F6, F8]. [F5]
thoughts.en: I revise Skeptic's comparison: the PM10 maximum now moved from 93 to 54 µg/m³ [F5]. I find Ada petlja at the maximum for PM10, NO2 and PM2.5 in the same labelled hour, a spatial convergence rather than evidence of a citywide increase [F4, F6, F8].
hypotheses: I suspect a shared local influence at Ada petlja could help explain the coincident pollutant maxima, but the source remains unidentified [F4, F6, F8].
questions: Do the pollutant maxima remain together at Ada petlja in the next labelled hour [F4, F6, F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Pretpostavljam da bi zajednički lokalni uticaj na Adi petlji mogao pomoći da se objasni podudaranje maksimuma zagađujućih materija, ali izvor ostaje nepoznat [F4, F6, F8].
questions_sr: Da li maksimumi zagađujućih materija ostaju zajedno na Adi petlji u sledećem označenom satu [F4, F6, F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the locations of the next pollutant maxima, not merely their magnitudes [F4, F6, F8].

thoughts.sr: Mali model je ocenio iznenađenje veza: F49 5/5, F50 5/5, F51 5/5, F12 3/5, F5 1/5, F7 1/5, F9 1/5. Procena, ne merenje.
thoughts.en: A small model rated the connections by surprise: F49 5/5, F50 5/5, F51 5/5, F12 3/5, F5 1/5, F7 1/5, F9 1/5. An estimate, not a measurement.

thoughts.sr: Odbacujem Connector-ov zaključak o podudaranju: Ada petlja prednjači po PM10 sa 41 µg/m³ i NO2 sa 58 µg/m³, ali maksimum PM2.5 iznosi 19 µg/m³ na stanici Dragiša Mišović [F4, F6, F8]. Vidim da svi ovi maksimumi na stanicama opadaju između označenih sati, ali ne vidim dokaz da se stanje poboljšalo na svakoj stanici [F5, F7, F9]. [F2][F4][F5][F6]
thoughts.en: I reject Connector's convergence: Ada petlja leads PM10 at 41 µg/m³ and NO2 at 58 µg/m³, but the PM2.5 maximum is 19 µg/m³ at Dragiša Mišović [F4, F6, F8]. I see all these station maxima declining between the labelled hours, not evidence that every station improved [F5, F7, F9]. [F2][F4][F5][F6]
questions: Did concentrations decline at individual stations, or did only the cross-station maxima decline [F5, F7, F9]?
questions_sr: Da li su koncentracije opale na pojedinačnim stanicama ili su opali samo maksimumi među stanicama [F5, F7, F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-matched readings across the labelled hours [F5, F7, F9].

thoughts.sr: Idem korak dalje od razlike koju pravi Skeptic: Krnjača beleži minimum za obe mere čestica, dok su njihovi maksimumi zabeleženi na različitim stanicama [F4, F8]. Uporedio bih taj prostorni obrazac sa podacima građanskih senzora, ali to što su njihovi podaci primljeni pre 10 min ne potvrđuje vremensku usklađenost sa satom koji je označila SEPA [F10, F3]. [F10][F34][F37][F39]
thoughts.en: I take Skeptic's distinction further: Krnjača marks the minimum for both particle measures, while their maxima belong to different stations [F4, F8]. I would compare that spatial pattern with citizen sensors, but their reception 10 min ago does not establish alignment with SEPA's labelled hour [F10, F3]. [F10][F34][F37][F39]
hypotheses: The shared particle minima at Krnjača may reflect a spatial pattern that nearby citizen sensors could corroborate after time alignment [F4, F8, F10, F3].
questions: Do citizen sensors near Krnjača reproduce its particle contrast with the stations holding the maxima when measurement times are aligned [F4, F8, F10, F3]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički minimumi za čestice u Krnjači mogu odražavati prostorni obrazac koji bi obližnji građanski senzori mogli da potvrde nakon vremenskog usklađivanja [F4, F8, F10, F3].
questions_sr: Da li građanski senzori u blizini Krnjače pokazuju istu razliku u vrednostima čestica između Krnjače i stanica na kojima su zabeleženi maksimumi kada se vremena merenja usklade [F4, F8, F10, F3]?
thoughts.next_check: Check citizen-sensor locations and measurement timestamps before comparing their particle readings with the SEPA spatial pattern [F10, F3, F4, F8].

thoughts.sr: Ažuriram poređenje prijema podataka za Connector: podaci sa građanskih senzora poslednji put su mi stigli pre 2 min, a podaci iz SEPA pre 57 min; time se ne potvrđuje da su vremena merenja usklađena [F10, F2]. Vidim da se prikazani broj slobodnih mesta na Parkiralište "Ada" menja sa 771 na 315, ali bez vremenskih oznaka merenja ne mogu da vremenski povežem tu promenu sa očitavanjima kvaliteta vazduha [F12, F11]. [F12][F2][F10][F17]
thoughts.en: I update Connector's reception comparison: citizen sensors last reached me 2 min ago, SEPA 57 min ago; this does not establish aligned measurement times [F10, F2]. I see displayed free spaces at Parkiralište "Ada" move from 771 to 315, but without measurement timestamps I cannot place that change alongside the air readings [F12, F11]. [F12][F2][F10][F17]
hypotheses: The change at Parkiralište "Ada" could reflect a localized redistribution of parking demand rather than a citywide pattern; comparable changes at other locations remain unchecked [F12, F11].
questions: Do other parking locations show matching or opposing changes when their measurement times can be established [F11, F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Pretpostavljam da bi promena na Parkiralište "Ada" mogla da odražava lokalnu preraspodelu potražnje za parkingom, a ne obrazac na nivou celog grada; još nisam proverio uporedive promene na drugim lokacijama [F12, F11].
questions_sr: Da li druge parking lokacije pokazuju promene u istom ili suprotnom smeru kada mogu da utvrdim vremena njihovih merenja [F11, F12]?
